summary: Abandoned closeout draft for the Esmervane Pharmaceuticals EP-7 capsule ICH chamber programme. Records the initial pull and cancellation instruction; later pulls were not performed and no final stability or shelf-life conclusion was issued.
header: Westravelle Analytical Ltd, a Tarnovell company
footer: Westravelle Analytical Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

blocks.p: Esmervane Pharmaceuticals terminated the EP-7 formulation following a clinical strategy change and authorised closure of the remaining Stability pulls. This draft records the initial observation and the boundary of work performed under {{PRJ0104:project_id}}. It has not passed the report release gate and is not a final stability report.

table.caption: Table 1 Initial pull only; assay as percent label claim and impurities as area percent

blocks.p: The initial assay was {{PRJ0104:stability.t0_assay}} percent label claim. The observation applies to the initial pull only. It does not establish change with time, comparability between conditions or a shelf-life interval.
Cancellation is a programme decision and shall not be recorded as analytical compliance at unperformed timepoints.

Start and interim dates identify the administrative chronology. They do not by themselves demonstrate a storage interval or a completed pull. Executed observations must remain linked to the batch card, chamber entry and sequence sheet.
This draft was opened on 03 Dec 2024 to preserve the cancellation boundary. The final report number and approval date have not been allocated.

EP-7 capsules were assigned to {{PRJ0104:lims_id}} for the ICH chamber programme. The accession identifies the material trail; it does not replace stability lot identity, container identity or placement location on the batch card.
The initial observation is the only numerical pull represented here. Receipt, preparation and allocation references remain to be collated before a controlled archival closeout can be signed.

rows: Disposition not reconciled in this draft
table.caption: Table 3 Custody references

blocks.p: The cancellation instruction does not mark containers as destroyed or returned. Physical disposition requires its own authority and signed custody entry.

Assay and related-substances observations belong to the applicable sequence sheet and raw-data trail. Saira Mahmood is the technical closeout contact. Preserve the method version used at execution rather than substituting a later template revision.

The initial entry does not certify that calculations, system suitability and traceability have been checked for report issue. No trend fit, degradation rate or projection is calculated from this initial observation.

Esmervane Pharmaceuticals authorised closure of remaining pulls after terminating the formulation for a clinical strategy change. This stops the scheduled analytical programme. It neither changes the initial observation nor creates a final stability conclusion.
Leon Wu is to retain the schedule with cancellation visible. Outstanding retrieval entries must be distinguished from completed pulls; cancelled entries must not receive passing results.

rows: Formulation terminated after clinical strategy change
No final stability or shelf-life conclusion

blocks.p: Outstanding: attach the instruction and reconcile its scope against chamber inventory. Material-disposition questions remain open.

Scheduled pulls after the initial observation remain unperformed in this closeout. Identify them as cancelled following the client instruction, rather than missing measurements suitable for interpolation.

rows: No final trend or shelf-life assessment
table.caption: Table 6 Programme closure

blocks.p: Do not populate later timepoints from planning entries or carry the initial assay forward. The initial interval and condition remain the limits of the analytical statement.
Restarting testing would require a new written scope, confirmation of custody and assessment of intervening storage. It is not authorised by this draft.

rows: Head of Analytical Services and QA

blocks.p: This register records unfinished work and does not certify completion. No recipient copy has been authorised. Retain this file in the unreleased location until evidence and disposition are settled.
